description: Generalized assignment branch-and-bound inspired by MTG:
- Bounding: Combine a fractional-knapsack upper bound per resource with a per-task bound;
use the best feasible assignment as the incumbent.
- Branching: Select the task with fewest feasible resources, then largest profit regret;
try feasible resources in descending profit order.
- Configuration: max_nodes=-1 performs exact search; nonnegative max_nodes limits visited nodes,
not the original Fortran backtracking counter. Return a bound and whether search completed.
Accept positive integer inputs within safe 32-bit objective range, up to 10 resources and 100 tasks.
